quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 933,791.45 thousand, up 10.99% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 71,555.91 thousand, down 28.77%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 38,877.39 thousand, down 47.33%; operating cash flow RMB 51,923.11 thousand, down 75.40% on much higher cash paid for goods. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 198,831.54 thousand, Q2 RMB 234,523.74 thousand, Q3 RMB 218,889.74 thousand, Q4 RMB 281,546.43 thousand; Q4 net profit RMB 31,448.90 thousand. The company attributes the profit decline to slower telecom demand and fiercer competition, where it priced strategically to hold share, and to strategic spending on R&D, new DCI and high-speed module capacity and the Thailand base; it says Q4 revenue and net profit grew both YoY and QoQ.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue RMB 933,791.45 thousand (+10.99%); net profit RMB 71,555.91 thousand (-28.77%); Q4 revenue RMB 281,546.43 thousand

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products and regions (annual report, 2025): transmission products RMB 638,044.21 thousand (-11.84%, gross margin 29.03%, down 3.83 points); access and data products RMB 281,722.66 thousand (+180.55%, gross margin 23.92%, up 9.16 points); main-business gross margin 27.46%, down 3.24 points. Overseas revenue RMB 157,347.91 thousand (+24.35%, gross margin 34.17%); domestic RMB 762,418.96 thousand (+8.79%). Volumes: transmission products 1,700,417 units sold (+8.53%), 1,978,799 produced; access and data products 312,494 sold (-27.17%), which the company attributes to a changed customer mix that cut low-value access optical devices. The company says it shifted from a telecom-centred strategy to telecom and datacom in parallel with a global push; inventory rose 54.06% to RMB 545,464.00 thousand, mainly stocking to enter the datacom market.
quarterly_data.figure: access and data products RMB 281,722.66 thousand (+180.55%); transmission RMB 638,044.21 thousand (-11.84%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (annual report, 2025): 400G coherent modules completed small-batch trial production; 800G coherent module devices achieved key breakthroughs with orders delivered; 400G/800G datacom modules were iterated and won small-batch customer orders; 1.6T datacom modules completed product development on three routes (EML, silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate); 50G PON products passed customer certification with small-batch orders; tunable / dense-wavelength modules sampled with small-batch orders. C+L gapless SOA single-channel amplifiers ship in volume, and C/L-band multi-wavelength amplifiers (over 2W output) for hollow-core fibre entered the market. 400G/600G DCI cards were delivered in batches (with C6T+L6T system deployment for a customer); 800G cards completed sample development and verification; 1.6T cards are in pre-research. In North America the company formally won data-center interconnect product orders and started delivery.
quarterly_data.figure: 1.6T datacom modules developed on EML, silicon photonics and TFLN; North American DCI orders, delivery started

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: OCS (annual report): a 32x32 silicon-waveguide OCS won an overseas sample order and a next-generation 64x64 OCS is in development; the OCS R&D project has a planned budget of RMB 50,000.00 thousand (RMB 8,745.84 thousand spent in 2025), targeting 128-port, 256-port and stackable low-latency, low-power optical switches on a silicon-waveguide plus array-amplifier design. 2026 plan: speed up OCS iteration and complete submission of the 64x64 product for testing.
quarterly_data.figure: 32x32 OCS overseas sample order; 64x64 in development

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spending RMB 110,288.91 thousand, up 6.52%, 11.81% of revenue (12.31% in 2024), none capitalised; R&D staff 227 (27.92% of employees), the team up 14.65%; 11 invention patents granted. Projects: computing / data-center modules (budget RMB 150,000.00 thousand) - silicon photonics platform initially built, 800G and 1.6T silicon-photonics modules developed and being pushed to mass production, including a 1.6T module on single-channel 200G silicon photonics; transmission modules - an 800G (4x200G) medium/long-reach product completed, which the company calls the first commercial use of lithium niobate in a client-side module, plus a 25G tunable module; 400G CFP2 DCO and 400G QSFP-DD coherent modules developed and pushed to mass production; 800G DCI completed sample development and verification; 50G PON developed and moving to small batches; ultra-long-haul unrepeatered products (450km+) in small-batch production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): keep R&D intensity matched to the revenue growth target, focused on 1.6T/3.2T modules and silicon-based OCS for AI clusters, next-generation DCI systems and coherent modules, and 50G PON, 5G-A/6G fronthaul and backbone upgrades. Product priorities: accelerate customer introduction and volume ramp of 1.6T modules on EML, silicon photonics and thin-film lithium niobate routes to deliver in batches within the window, and push DCI further at North American and leading domestic cloud providers to enlarge orders. Market: deepen work with North American cloud providers, leading internet companies and top equipment makers, aiming to move from breakthrough to main supplier in key customers' supply chains and raise the overseas revenue share. Operations: the Thailand base is to complete its capacity ramp and run stably.
